run_setup_install: run the setup.py install script to build and install the rlax python package
get_version_rlax: get the version string from rlax/__init__.py by parsing the __version__ variable
parse_requirements_file: parse a requirements text file and return a list of non-empty, non-comment lines
find_namespace_packages: find all namespace packages in the project excluding test files
build_python_module_setup: build a python module setup configuration with name, version, dependencies, and classifiers
